description: This file defines a RecipeRepositorySqlite class that acts as a data repository backed by SQLite, providing LiveData sources for recipes and categories, and includes methods for CRUD operations and searches within recipes.

classes.name: RecipeRepositorySqlite
classes.description: A singleton repository class providing access to recipe data stored in an SQLite database, with methods for retrieval, search, update, delete, and favorites management.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of all recipes managed by the repository.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of recipes matching the search query.

methods.name: favorites
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of favorite recipes.

methods.name: byCategory
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of recipes filtered by category.

methods.name: categories
methods.description: Returns a LiveData list of available recipe categories.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new recipe to the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Asynchronously updates an existing recipe in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a recipe from the database.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the favorite status of a recipe.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a recipe by its ID.

methods.name: live
methods.description: Helper function to create a LiveData object from a provider function.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides the singleton instance of the repository class.
